title: What Happens When You Call 911 While Running From Police
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On July 7, 2022, the Vernon County Sheriff's Office received information from another county regarding the search for a male involved in a serious ongoing case. The Wisconsin DOC was preparing to issue an arrest warrant for him. Later that day, law enforcement tracked the individual's phone, determining his location. A deputy monitoring traffic soon spotted the male's vehicle in Genoa, WI and attempted a traffic stop. However, the man accelerated and evaded the deputies for several miles. In an ironic turn of events, during the pursuit, the suspect decided to give 911 a call.

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
